test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 470 liters of a mixture of milk and water contains 5% of water. A mischievous boy added some water in the mixture and now there is 6% water in the new mixture. Find the quantity of water added by the boy in the mixture.
solution:
Given:

A mixture of 470 liters of milk and water contains 5% water.

Calculation:

Let x liter water be added

5% of 470 liter = 23.5 liter water

Now, according to question,

 (23.5 + x)/(470 + x)× 100 = 6 (∵ x liter water will also be added in mixture)

⇒ 2350 + 100x = 2820 + 6x

⇒ 94x = 470

⇒ x = 5 liter

∴ 5 liter water must be added to make water 6% in the new mixture.
